free_tier.stated: no free plan: Micro replaced the free plan and costs $19/year, billed yearly only; a time-limited free trial needs no card, its length unverified: behind a sign-up
free_tier.notes: Micro: unlimited mailboxes and addresses per account, almost unlimited domains, 200 incoming and 20 outgoing messages per day, 5 GB of soft storage. Mini is $9/month or $90/year with 1000 in/day, 100 out/day and 30 GB. Limits are counted per account across all its domains and mailboxes.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no maximum message or attachment size is stated on the captured pages

retention.stated: no hard storage quota: the 5 GB of Micro is soft and mail never bounces for full storage; an account over quota for seven days is blocked and, uncleared, purged after 30 days

egress.terms: not applicable: a mailbox; outbound mail is counted in messages, 20 per day on Micro with a 25% tolerance before sends are rejected
egress.free_allowance: 20 outgoing messages per day on Micro

interface_detail: IMAP at imap.migadu.com (993, TLS), POP at pop.migadu.com (995, TLS) and SMTP at smtp.migadu.com (465, TLS; port 587 also answers); CalDAV and CardDAV; an administration REST API in early beta at https://api.migadu.com/v1/ with HTTP Basic authentication by account email and API key
tooling: any IMAP, POP or SMTP client; IMAPSync for migration per the vendor guides; the beta REST API manages domains and mailboxes
chaining: a flat-priced account with unlimited mailboxes and addresses across many domains; 20 outgoing messages per day bind first on Micro, so it suits receiving on many domains more than sending.

limits.value: 20 outgoing messages per day on Micro, per account, with up to 25% tolerance before sends are rejected
200 incoming messages per day on Micro, per account; past the 25% tolerance incoming mail is deferred to the next day
5 GB of soft storage on Micro, per account

binding_note: 20 outgoing messages per day is the first ceiling on Micro; storage is soft and mailboxes and addresses are unlimited.

identity_cost.detail: signup asks for a full name and an existing email address that receives a confirmation link, with an optional organization name; no card for the trial. The paid plan is paid by card through Stripe, by a PayPal prepayment to the account balance, or in Bitcoin arranged through support. Domains on free TLDs are refused, so a paid domain is needed.

reliability_note: a trial account can be limited or ended without notice; an account over quota for seven days is blocked and purged 30 days later
confidence_note: plans and quotas read from the vendor pages; imap.migadu.com:993 accepted a TCP connection and smtp.migadu.com:587 answered with an ESMTP banner; no login or send was made
